verdict.rationale: Requesty exposes its request-time features through an OpenAI-compatible API: model routing, structured outputs, images, PDFs, web search, reasoning and streaming, plus referencing saved prompts by prompt_id. That covers the inference half of the story. Nothing shows a management API for what is configured elsewhere: analytics is described as a dashboard, and MCP server management (register servers, configure auth) is likely UI-driven. No published OpenAPI spec was found either. missing for 10: a documented admin/management API for API keys, service accounts, spend caps, fallback and load-balancing policies, guardrails, prompt-library authoring and MCP server registration; programmatic access to analytics; a published OpenAPI spec; independent confirmation of UI–API parity.
